ufbx is vendored from https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx at version 0.23.0.

Local changes (marked with "rbfx: upstream 0.23.1 fix" in ufbx.c):
- ufbxi_absolute_to_relative_path(): the buffer size accepts "../" for each empty path segment.
  Before the fix, a path with many empty segments wrote past the end of the buffer.
- ufbxi_read_nurbs_surface(): the load fails if Dimensions U * V overflows 32 bits.
- ufbxi_finalize_nurbs_basis(): the load fails if the NURBS order is too large.
These changes are copies of the upstream 0.23.1 fixes. Remove them when you update ufbx to 0.23.1 or later.
